canonicalAudit.finding: Canonical remains nominatively incomplete; do not decrement unreconciled counters without a proven current PUN partyId mapping. Recent investigation deltas must be folded into a later full reconstruction rather than guessed into the 92-party inventory.

investigation.subject: generic/eMSP tariff discovery for unresolved Italian CPOs
evidence: Current public EVVai surface exposes per-station prices across many Italian partner networks but identifies itself as eMobility Service Provider IT-EVV; these are eMSP prices and cannot substitute for direct CPO/ad-hoc tariffs.
Current comparison surfaces for Enel X Way list operator-specific roaming prices; these likewise cannot be promoted as direct tariffs for unresolved CPOs.
investigation.decision: Do not use EVVai, Enel X Way roaming tables, or analogous eMSP price surfaces as direct CPO tariff evidence. They remain discovery/corroboration only.
investigation.antiRepeat: Do not repeat generic roaming-price searches for unresolved CPOs unless a result exposes a first-party CPO endpoint, QR/ad-hoc surface, or deterministic direct-price mapping.

priorityDecision.next: Continue reconciliation of current PUN partyIds not yet named in canonical; only investigate a candidate as network/class-wide when identity and first-party direct tariff scope can both be established.
